question: Do initially complementary linked memories remain complementary continuously or only at endpoints, and which finite-horizon local records can be bounded?
source_equations: docs/research/gross-linked-memory.md; preparation v0.1 JSON SHA256 cd96483516183eab5716103828d24780a1a893b9c27e6712bd62aaee9bfd913d; commuting full-word claim corrected before lock

method.action: Unchanged SS OPS 1 lambda=0, H_a=kappa d-dagger P_a d, d=z_i-z_j, P_a=w_a w_a-dagger; canonical reciprocal amplitude law and its pure coherent commutator lift. Inactive variables fixed.
method.units: Amplitudes, couplings and gate parameter dimensionless; kappa=pi/2, each gate s in [0,1]. Gate parameter is not physical proper time.
method.domain: Three coherent two-component ports, two unit memory projectors; supplied A=(ports1,2,memoryA), B=(ports2,3,memoryB); serial A then B, 64 cycles. Two active phase cases get 32-cycle full physical tangent studies.
method.boundaries: All ports/memories retained, identity transports, no external input or loss. No spatial mesh/domain or continuum boundary; isolated event words and physical order controls replace inapplicable mesh/domain refinements.
method.initial_data: Seven deterministic original preparations: dark, initially-commuting, active-plus, active-minus, noncomplement, coherence-plus and coherence-minus. Case2 is preserved as a deformation witness; its isolated gates, not full word, are exact commuting controls. N=1; both memory norms=1. No random case selection.
method.solver: Reuse existing exact_gate at 17 samples per gate; independently integrate full W,PA,PB with DOP853 rtol=1e-11 atol=1e-13 max_step=1/16. Halve both tolerances and use 33 samples. Differentiate exact gate with Frechet exponential, retaining 12 wave+4 physical memory dimensions, and compare centered differences at 1e-5 and 5e-6. Independently reconstruct centered local record differences from saved finite_states at both steps and every prefix.
method.tolerances: Normalized coherent-state, record and conservation residuals <=1e-9 on both refinements; direct half-tolerance comparison <=1e-9. Relative tangent agreement <=1e-4 at every prefix. Local record target 1e-3 from admissible initial error <=1e-6: preparation/integration/omitted/readout allocations each2.5e-4. Carry exponential sensitivity across switches without resetting. Global exact-region bound gives zero full-cycle preparation horizon; numerical/readout certification remains unresolved without validated enclosures. Include record derivative agreement and step halving, normalized by max(1, norm of saved record derivative), in the unchanged relative 1e-4 tangent gate.

hypotheses.prediction: Under explicit vanishing active commutators a restricted complementary family persists throughout every event; generic complementarity alone does not imply this.
A trajectory may return at endpoints while deforming inside gates; evaluate endpoint persistence separately.
The active preparations have nonzero initial constraint derivatives; universal continuous persistence is falsified analytically. Endpoint defects may also be resolved.
Apparent persistence or accurate records may reflect numerical error or insensitive readout; exact/operator refinement and full tangent sectors discriminate these effects.

controls.purpose: Discriminate representation mismatch and numerical error
controls.method: Exact amplitude samples versus independent full W/P DOP853 at two tolerances; refine within-event sampling17 to33. Compare plus/minus coherence witnesses with identical local rays.

controls.purpose: Test actual order and reciprocal response
controls.method: For all seven preparations, isolated A, isolated B, reversed B then A, and deliberately frozen memories. Reverse order need not agree.

controls.purpose: Separate description changes from physical records
controls.method: Rotate every port and memory with fixed U(2); separately multiply only all waves by a common phase; restore the description and compare full invariant histories.

controls.purpose: Retain genuine memory and orientation directions and test the prediction norm
controls.method: Active plus/minus: 16 chart directions, exact-word Frechet derivative, centered steps1e-5 and5e-6, +/- admissible initial1e-6 perturbations. Independent variational ODE is an engineering benchmark. No fixed-J deletion or port-phase fitting.
